mentions.name: EOModeller
mentions.description: Web-based UML modelling tool with live updates between two browser windows and iPad pen input support. It also includes ArchiMate support, currently disabled pending a license fee. The tool went through several technical iterations (wasm, then SwiftUI, then HTML/JavaScript) and is used daily by its creator, who is now seeking feedback from other users.
mentions.problem: Most existing UML modelling tools were not very good, so it was built as a yak-shaving project for daily personal use.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been working on a web based UML modelling tool for a while now. It's gone through a few technical iterations before this version really progressed well. It does live updates between two browser windows, and supports iPad pen input.
